items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff doesn’t think Kimi Antonelli “would have lasted in other teams”
items.summaryEn: Toto Wolff said that Kimi Antonelli's nine-race pointless streak in 2025 would have gotten him fired by any other F1 team.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫认为，基米·安东内利“在其他车队恐怕待不下去”。
托托·沃尔夫承认，安东内利在2025赛季连续9场比赛未得分，这样的表现若放在其他任何F1车队，他早就被解雇了。
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1对年轻人才而言是一台残酷的绞肉机。如果一名新秀不能立即拿出表现，通常很快就会被车队负责人扫地出门。
对梅赛德斯来说，押注青少年安东内利取代刘易斯·汉密尔顿是终极冒险。而正如车队领队托托·沃尔夫坦然承认的那样，在这位意大利人2025年新秀赛季中，曾有一段黑暗时期，发车区上几乎任何其他车队都会选择终止合作。
在巴西大奖赛第三次自由练习赛后，沃尔夫接受天空体育F1的娜奥米·希夫和西蒙·拉森比采访，花了一点时间回顾他新加冕的世界冠军究竟离悬崖边缘有多近。
在安东内利于墨西哥城举起2026年冠军奖杯之前，他必须挺过一段噩梦般的低迷期。
“我特别自豪的是，我认为在经历了一个并不算压倒性的F2赛季后，他在其他车队恐怕都撑不下来，”沃尔夫在天空体育的转播中坦言。“还有去年那段连续九场比赛一分未得的时期。”
当压力达到绝对顶峰、批评者质疑这个厂队席位时，布拉克利车队上下团结一致。
他们无视外界的噪音，专注于遥测数据。
“我们只是相信自己的数据，相信我们对性格和潜力的感觉，”沃尔夫解释道。“因为有很多人站出来说，多么了不起的天才。而那不是这段历程。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
沃尔夫和他的高层领导团队没有让当时19岁的他淹没在银箭聚光灯下的巨大压力中，而是围绕他建立了一座心理堡垒。他们给了他其他车队根本不愿提供的时间。
沃尔夫指出：“这段旅程就是培养天赋、悉心栽培、指导、为他遮风挡雨、保护他。最终，你知道，他在车里的表现简直令人惊叹。”
最终的证明出现在墨西哥，安东内利锁定冠军。沃尔夫的耐心不仅让一位世代级天才免于被F1机器摧毁，还造就了F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
detailEn: Toto Wolff doesn’t think Kimi Antonelli “would have lasted in other teams”
Toto Wolff admits Kimi Antonelli's 9-race pointless streak in 2025 would have gotA him fired by any other F1 team
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Formula 1 is a vicious meat grinder for young talent. If a rookie doesn't perform immediately, there is usually a very short leash before a team principal shows them the door.

For Mercedes, taking a massive gamble on teenager Andrea Kimi Antonelli to replace Lewis Hamilton was the ultimate risk. And as team boss Toto Wolff freely admits, there was a dark stretch during the Italian's 2025 rookie campaign where almost any other team on the grid would have pulled the plug.

Speaking to Sky Sports F1’s Naomi Schiff and Simon Lazenby following Free Practice 3 at the Brazilian Grand Prix, Wolff took a moment to reflect on exactly how close his newly crowned world champion came to the brink.
Before Antonelli hoisted the 2026 championship trophy in Mexico City, he had to survive a nightmare slump.

"What I'm particularly proud of is that I don't think he would have lasted in other teams after an F2 season, which wasn't overwhelming," Wolff confessed on the Sky broadcast. "And this spell of nine races without any points last year."
When the pressure was at its absolute peak, and critics were questioning the factory seat, the Brackley squad closed ranks.
They ignored the outside noise and looked at the telemetry.
"We just trusted our data, trusted our feeling about the personality and the potential," Wolff explained. "Because there's so many that came out and said, what a talent. And that wasn't the journey."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Instead of letting the then-19-year-old drown in the immense pressure of the Silver Arrows spotlight, Wolff and his senior leadership team built a psychological fortress around him. They gave him the time that other teams simply refuse to offer.
"The journey was developing the talent, nurturing, mentoring, shielding him, protecting him," Wolff noted. "And eventually, you know, he in the car is just delivered absolutely amazingly."

The ultimate vindication arrived in Mexico when Antonelli secured the crown. Wolff's patience didn't just save a generational talent from being destroyed by the F1 machine - it built the youngest world champion in F1 history.
keyPointsZh: 沃尔夫承认，安东内利在2025赛季作为新秀曾经历一段连续9场比赛未得分的低谷期。
报道指出，F1对年轻车手极为残酷，新秀若不能立即拿出表现，通常很快就会被车队负责人放弃。
keyPointsEn: Wolff admitted that Antonelli went through a nine-race pointless streak during his 2025 rookie season.
The report notes that F1 is a vicious meat grinder for young talent, and rookies who don't perform immediately are usually given a very short leash before a team principal shows them the door.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton set for new penalty, will start F1 Brazilian GP from back of grid
items.summaryEn: Ferrari has announced that Lewis Hamilton will have to start the Brazilian Grand Prix from the back of the grid due to engine trouble requiring further power unit components. He had already received a 10-place grid drop on Saturday morning for using his fifth internal combustion engine of the season, exceeding his quota for the first time.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿将面临新的处罚，将从F1巴西大奖赛的最后一位发车
引擎故障意味着刘易斯·汉密尔顿不得不使用更多动力单元部件
法拉利宣布，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将不得不从F1巴西大奖赛的最后一位发车。
汉密尔顿在周六上午被给予本赛季第五台内燃机，由于首次超出配额，他被罚退10位发车。
然而，这位七届世界冠军在第三次自由练习赛中经历了一段波折。他在练习赛前半段报告称，新引擎传来“奇怪的振动”，而且发动机制动比平时更强烈，最终他在中性胎圈速排名中仅列第八。
片刻之后，汉密尔顿最终不得不明确进站，赛车冒出烟雾。因此他未能进行任何软胎的测试。
法拉利现已宣布，汉密尔顿的动力单元已被拆下以作进一步检查，并将为SF-26安装一套全新的动力总成——这意味着他将面临进一步的发车位处罚，等同于从队尾起步。
汉密尔顿一直渴望提升自己在英特拉格斯的获胜纪录，他曾在2016年、2018年和2021年在此夺冠——在18场比赛中仅获胜三次。
当被问及是否有可能在若泽·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道追平迈克尔·舒马赫四胜的纪录时，汉密尔顿澄清道：“嗯，我在这里赢的次数并没有那么多，所以对此我并不太满意。”
“三次胜利，我很感激我取得的三次胜利，但我从2007年起就一直来这里参赛。对我来说这是一个很低的纪录，我想要改变它。这就是我所专注的事情。”
他实现这一目标的可能性如今已很渺茫，但圣保罗站的比赛仍将标志着他第400场大奖赛发车——仅次于费尔南多·阿隆索目前的444场。
“这有点疯狂。我从未想过我会达到这样的数字，”汉密尔顿说道，他完成F1首秀时，当时的史上纪录保持者是里卡多·帕特雷斯，为256场比赛。
“这很疯狂，因为我仍然觉得自己年轻，不管人们怎么说，你上周看到了我的杆位，我仍然有节奏，我仍然有速度，我仍然有奉献精神，这是最重要的，还有专注。”
“对我来说，那个数字有点无关紧要。能在巴西这里拥有它很美好。我听说过一些摄影师已经在这里参加了500场比赛；在某个阶段，那可能就是我所在的位置。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton set for new penalty, will start F1 Brazilian GP from back of grid
Engine trouble means Leiws Hamilton has to take on further power unit parts
Lewis Hamilton will have to start Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix from the back of the grid, Ferrari has announced.
Hamilton was given his fifth internal combustion engine of the season on Saturday morning, landing a 10-place grid drop as he was exceeding his quota for the first time.

However, the seven-time world champion endured a troubled Free Practice 3 session. He reported “strange vibrations” coming from his new engine as well as more powerful engine braking than usual during the first half of the session, as he ended up just eighth-fastest in the medium-tyre pecking order.
Hamilton eventually had to pit definitively moments later, with smoke emanating from the car. He therefore did not get any soft-compound running.

Ferrari has now announced that Hamilton’s power unit has been removed for further checks with a brand-new powertrain to be installed on the SF-26 – meaning he will get further grid penalties equating to a back-of-the-grid start.
Hamilton had been keen to improve his winning record at Interlagos, a track where he took victories in 2016, 2018 and 2021 – just three times across 18 races.

Asked about potentially equalling Michael Schumacher’s record of four wins at Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace, Hamilton clarified: “Well, I haven't won here that many times, so I'm not too happy about that.
“Three wins, I'm grateful for the three wins that I've had, but I've been coming here since 2007. That's a low record for me that I want to change. That's what I'm focused on.”
His odds of doing so are now remote, but the Sao Paulo race will still mark his 400th grand prix start – second only to Fernando Alonso’s current 444.

“It's kind of crazy. I never ever thought that I would be reaching numbers like that,” Hamilton said, having made his F1 debut at a time when the all-time record holder was Riccardo Patrese with 256 races.

“It's crazy because I still feel young, and regardless of the things that people say, you saw my pole last week, I still have the pace, I still have the speed and I still have the dedication, which is most important, and the focus.

“For me, that number is kind of irrelevant. It's beautiful to be able to have that here in Brazil. I've heard of some photographers who have been here for 500 races; at some stage that's probably where I'll be.”
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在周六上午被给予本赛季第五台内燃机，这是他首次超出配额，因此被罚退10位。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton was given his fifth internal combustion engine of the season on Saturday morning, his first time exceeding his quota, resulting in a 10-place grid drop.

detailZh: 弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔个人出资100万美元，资助埃斯特班·奥康的首次F1参赛
在埃斯特班·奥康的F1生涯或许正走向尾声之际，托托·沃尔夫和弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔发表看法，并回忆了他的崛起历程
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫透露，弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔个人出资100万美元，资助埃斯特班·奥康在2016年代表马诺F1车队参加半个赛季的比赛。
奥康在2015年GP3赛季前加入梅赛德斯青训项目，并在瓦塞尔的ART Grand Prix车队以惊人的方式夺得冠军：18场比赛中14次登上领奖台，其中包括连续九次获得第二名。
同为梅赛德斯青训车手的帕斯卡尔·维尔莱因经验更为丰富，当时已是DTM卫冕冠军，他在2016年与里奥·哈里安托一同代表马诺车队完成F1首秀，而后者最终预算枯竭。因此，奥康临时转投DTM、再次与ART车队合作，随后获得了参加该赛季最后九场大奖赛的机会——前提是他能凑齐所需资金。
“在梅赛德斯，我们接手了埃斯特班的管理事务，这其实是格温（拉格鲁，梅赛德斯青训主管）的功劳，”沃尔夫回忆道。“然后我们同意与弗雷德（瓦塞尔）在GP3合作，我们一起赢得了冠军。
“之后F1并没有真正的机会。DTM这扇门，是我们一起打开的。再后来，我不知道这件事是否真的为人所知，当斯帕站开始马诺突然出现一个空缺席位时，需要两百万美元，我们（在梅赛德斯）说我们可以为这个席位提供一百万，但还差一百万，弗雷德自掏腰包补上了这笔钱，给了埃斯特班这个机会。”
埃斯特班·奥康，马诺车队，托托·沃尔夫，西里尔·阿比特布尔，帕特·弗莱，弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔
奥康的F1生涯正面临威胁，因为他在墨西哥大奖赛上发生争执后，失去了本赛季剩余时间里的哈斯车队席位。他留在发车格上的唯一现实途径是凯迪拉克的第二个席位，但据了解，这位大奖赛冠军得主很可能将前往阿斯顿·马丁担任储备车手。
“评论另一支车队发生的事情很困难，”瓦塞尔说道。“我自己的车手们已经够我忙的了，而且我不知道在青山[小松，车队领队]、哈斯、车队和车手之间发生了什么。我不想发表任何评论。
“对埃斯特班来说这当然很遗憾，因为我认为他是一个纯粹的竞争者。整个赛季他投入了大量精力来留在F1，我们需要对此给予极大的尊重。现在，我不会对这种情况发表任何评论。”
沃尔夫补充道：“在所有这些年里，我认为我们都非常支持他，也非常努力地确保埃斯特班能获得尽可能好的机会。显然，之后他经历了几次车队变动。”
“我认为到最后，事情发展到了Ayao需要代表车队、保护车队免受某些言论影响的地步。而另一方面，Esteban个人认为他所说的话并没有错。归根结底，你必须尊重车队说了算这一点。车队领队需要决定什么时候已经够了，而这就是Ayao所做的。”
detailEn: Fred Vasseur personally contributed $1m to Esteban Ocon’s first F1 drive
As Esteban Ocon’s F1 career perhaps reaches its twilight, Toto Wolff and Fred Vasseur weigh in – and reminisce about his rise
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has revealed Fred Vasseur personally contributed one million dollars to fund Esteban Ocon’s half-season at the Manor Formula 1 team in 2016.

Ocon joined Mercedes’ young-driver programme ahead of the 2015 GP3 season, claiming the title in remarkable fashion with 14 podiums in 18 races – including a string of nine consecutive second-place finishes – with Vasseur’s ART Grand Prix squad.

Fellow Mercedes junior Pascal Wehrlein, who was more experienced as the reigning DTM champion, got to make his F1 debut with Manor in 2016 alongside Rio Haryanto, whose budget eventually dried up. Having temporarily moved to DTM, again with ART, Ocon therefore got an opportunity to compete in the last nine grands prix of the season – provided he could find the required funding.

“At Mercedes we picked up the management of Esteban, due to Gwen [Lagrue, Mercedes academy boss], actually,” Wolff recounted. “Then [we] agreed to work with Fred [Vasseur] in GP3, we won the championship together.

“Then there wasn't really an opportunity in Formula 1. The DTM door, we did that together. And then, I don't know if that is actually known, when suddenly there appeared to be a free seat in Manor from Spa onwards, it needed two million dollars, and we [at Mercedes] were saying we can provide one million for that seat, but we were missing one million, and Fred put the money in personally to give Esteban the opportunity.”
Esteban Ocon, Manor Racing , Toto Wolff, Cyril Abiteboul, Pat Fry, Frederic Vasseur

Ocon’s F1 career is at threat after he lost his Haas drive for the remainder of the season after a falling-out at the Mexico Grand Prix. His only realistic avenue to stay on the grid is Cadillac’s second seat, but the grand prix winner is understood to likely be heading to Aston Martin as a reserve driver.

“To comment on what's happened in another team, it's difficult,” Vasseur said. “I have enough to do with my guys, and I don't know what's happened between Ayao [Komatsu, team principal], Haas, the team and the driver. I don't want to make any comment.

“For sure, it's a shame for Esteban because I think he's a pure competitor. He put a lot of energy all over the season to be in F1, and we need to have huge respect for this. Now, I won't make any comment on the situation.”

Wolff added: “Over all those years, I think we were all very supportive and very strong in trying to make sure that Esteban would have the best possible opportunity. Obviously, then he went through a couple of team changes.

“I think at the end it came to the point where Ayao needed to represent the team and protect the team from certain rhetoric. And on the other side, Esteban felt personally that he wasn't wrong in the things he said. And you've got to respect that at the end, the team calls the shots. The team principal needs to decide when it's enough, and that is what Ayao did.”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Max Verstappen fastest in final practice but faces grid penalties with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc

Max Verstappen was quickest from Kimi Antonelli in final practice in Brazil but will start at the back for Sunday's race; Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc also have penalties; watch Qualifying later on Saturday at 6pm (build-up from 5pm), live on Sky Sports F1
Max Verstappen goes fastest in the Sao Paulo Grand Prix final practice
Red Bull's Max Verstappen was fastest in final practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix but will serve grid penalties along with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc.

Verstappen pipped new Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli by 0.025s but will start at the back of the grid for a complete power unit change, while Hamilton and Leclerc have 10-grid place penalties for exceeding their internal combustion engine allocation.

Mercedes had already announced on Friday that George Russell will have a five-place penalty for a new internal combustion engine, the second time he has exceeded that part's limit, while the Ferrari drivers are being penalised for the first time, so have a bigger penalty.

Russell was fourth quickest and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had much stronger pace compared to Friday, after making significant changes to his car's setup, and was just 0.274s off the pace.
Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari is into the garage after engine issues during the third practice session at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
His team-mate Hamilton was limited to just seven laps due to an engine issue, which Ferrari are in a race to rectify ahead of qualifying.

items.originalTitle: What happened in final Brazil F1 practice
detailZh: 维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛最终练习赛中领跑，但将因引擎部件更换而获得后发位置处罚。
维斯塔潘是四位受处罚的领跑者之一——包括法拉利的赛车（每人10个位置）和拉塞尔（5个位置处罚）——他们已经在巴西的杆位争夺战中出局。
维斯塔潘在FP3中以1m11.622s的成绩领跑，比新世界冠军基米·安东内利快了0.025s。
红牛在夜间对维斯塔潘的赛车进行了重大改动，但这位四次世界冠军在FP3中仍对“糟糕”的转向表示不满。
兰多·诺里斯以0.131秒的差距成为麦凯轮车队第三快的车手，排在罗素驾驶的梅赛德斯之后位居第四。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔以0.274秒的差距成为第五快的车手，比维斯塔潘的基准成绩慢。
队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿没有能够进行排位赛模拟，因为他在比赛还剩大约25分钟时，不得不将他的法拉利车拖入维修区，原因是车尾冒烟。
这使他成为第12快的车手，他的最快圈速是在中胎上完成的。
法拉利刚刚为汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔的两辆赛车更换了新的内燃机。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂排在第六位，领先于两位来自小红牛的阿维德·林德布拉德和利亚姆·劳森，他们的速度都比红牛的伊萨克·哈德贾快，比维斯塔潘慢0.628秒。
前十名中，本土英雄加布里埃尔·博托莱托的奥迪排在最后，他的同胞、新秀拉斐尔·卡马拉在第十五位超过了奥利·贝尔曼超过十分之一。卡马拉的最快理论圈速实际上是所有车手中第十二快的，比贝尔曼的理论最佳圈速快近三十分之一。
兰斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁只完成了七圈，随后因为一个问题被迫返回维修区，这个问题让他失去了剩余的练习时间。
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯将在第八弯道因将某物从驾驶舱扔出而面临 stewards 的赛后调查。
即使是他的凯迪拉克车队也感到困惑，因为他的赛车工程师询问佩雷斯他扔出了什么。
“我不知道，嗯...有什么东西掉了，”佩雷斯解释道，“我想是无线电，你放无线电电缆的地方，一个小盒子。”
18 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+1.549秒
detailEn: Max Verstappen topped final practice ahead of Formula 1 qualifying at the Brazilian Grand Prix, knowing he’ll take a back-of-the-grid penalty for engine component changes.
Verstappen is one of four penalised frontrunners - along with the Ferraris (10 places each) and Russell (five-place penalty) - who are already out of the pole position fight in Brazil.
Verstappen topped FP3 on a 1m11.622s, just 0.025s faster than the new world champion Kimi Antonelli.
Red Bull made major changes to Verstappen’s car overnight but the four-time world champion was still complaining about his “terrible” steering in FP3.
Lando Norris was third-quickest for McLaren, 0.131s slower with Russell’s Mercedes rounding out the top four.
Charles Leclerc was fifth-fastest, 0.274s slower than Verstappen’s benchmark.
Team-mate Lewis Hamilton didn’t get to conduct a qualifying simulation because he had to pull his Ferrari into the pits with around 25 minutes remaining, due to smoke billowing from his Ferrari.
That left him 12th-fastest, with his fastest lap set on the mediums.
Ferrari had just fitted a new internal combustion engine to the cars of both Hamilton and Leclerc.
Oscar Piastri was sixth ahead of the two Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson, who were both faster than Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar, 0.628s adrift of Verstappen.

The top 10 was rounded out by home hero Gabriel Bortoleto’s Audi, with his fellow countryman, rookie Rafael Camara, outpacing Ollie Bearman by over a tenth in 15th place. Camara’s fastest theoretical lap was actually the 12th-best of all the drivers, almost three tenths up on Bearman’s theoretical best.
Lance Stroll’s Aston Martin managed just seven laps before he was forced to return his car to the garage with an issue that lost him the rest of the session.
Sergio Perez will face a post-session investigation by the stewards for throwing something out of the cockpit at Turn 8.
Even his Cadillac team were confused as his race engineer asked Perez what he threw out of his cockpit.
"I don't know it was, uh..something came off," Perez explained. "I think the radio, where you put the radio cables, a little box."
18 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.549s

items.originalTitle: F1 Brazilian GP: Max Verstappen edges out Kimi Antonelli in FP3
detailZh: F1巴西大奖赛：维斯塔潘在FP3中险胜安东内利
红牛和梅赛德斯的天才车手在伊纳戈斯赛道排位赛前占据领先位置
维斯塔潘在F1巴西大奖赛的第三场自由练习中创造了最快圈速，仅以微弱优势领先于安东内利，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿的法拉利赛车在FP3中遭遇机械故障
即将到来的降雨威胁导致所有车手都急忙冲上赛道 - 尤其是尼科·胡肯伯格，他的奥迪赛车在FP1中被新手弗雷迪·斯莱特造成致命故障，使他无法参加第二场练习。因此，这些圈数是德国车手本周的第一个圈数。
在练习赛的前40分钟，所有人都关注了中等轮胎复合物，基米·安东内利以1分12.209秒的速度最快，领先维斯塔潘0.075秒——尽管这位新世界冠军报告说方向盘有问题，而四次冠军得主表示他的方向盘“向右沉重”。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔排名第三，落后0.230秒，而乔治·罗素、利亚姆·劳森和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里落后安东内利半秒。劳森在第三部分赛道上创造了最快时间，比小红牛队友阿维德·林德布拉德快了0.5秒，比任何其他中游车手都快了几乎一秒。
汉密尔顿报告说他的新动力单元出现了“奇怪的振动”和“强大的引擎制动”，在哈吉亚之前仅排名第八快，哈吉亚描述他的小红牛22“几乎无法驾驶”。法拉利的这位车手的问题后来导致驾驶舱内出现烟雾，伴随着令人担忧的声音。
当赛道转向软橡胶时，维斯塔潘仅以1分11.622秒的成绩略胜安东内利，而梅赛德斯车手的成绩是1分11.647秒。兰多·诺里斯将他的麦凯轮提升到第三，落后0.131秒，接着是罗素和勒克莱尔——这意味着四支顶级车队在0.274秒内完成了圈速。
这次，林德布拉德比劳森快了十分之一，两人再次比奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和阿尔皮讷的皮埃尔·加斯利快了大约半秒。哈达尔也在分类中落后于两支小红牛，与领跑者维斯塔潘的差距为0.591秒。
汉密尔顿的问题意味着他被困在维修区，没有进行软胎测试，最终排名第12。
新秀拉斐尔·卡马拉以第15快的成绩完成，比队友奥利弗·贝尔曼快了0.128秒。
兰斯·斯特罗尔在练习赛进行15分钟后遇到了疑似ERS问题，这最终成为了致命的问题。
detailEn: F1 Brazilian GP: Max Verstappen edges out Kimi Antonelli in FP3
The Red Bull and Mercedes prodigies set the pace ahead of qualifying at Interlagos
Max Verstappen set the fastest time in Free Practice 3 at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix, narrowly edging out Kimi Antonelli as Lewis Hamilton’s Ferrari suffered a mechanical issue.

The impending threat of rain meant all drivers rushed onto the track – especially Nico Hulkenberg, whose Audi suffered a terminal issue at the hands of rookie Freddie Slater in FP1, preventing him from partaking in the second session at all. These laps were therefore the German’s first this weekend.

Everyone focused on the medium tyre compound in the opening 40 minutes of the session, Kimi Antonelli fastest in 1m12.209s, leading Verstappen by 0.075s – despite the new world champion reporting a steering wheel problem, while the four-time title winner reported his steering was “heavy to the right”.

Charles Leclerc was third, 0.230s adrift, while George Russell, Liam Lawson and Oscar Piastri were half a second down on Antonelli. Lawson, who set the fastest time in sector three, was nearly 0.5s quicker than Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad and almost one second faster than any other midfield driver.

Hamilton, who reported “strange vibrations” emanating from his new powertrain and “big engine braking”, was just eighth-fastest ahead of Hadjar, who described his RB22 as “close to undriveable”. The Ferrari man’s issue would later lead to “smoke in the cockpit” amid a worrying sound.

As the field switched to soft rubber, Verstappen narrowly edged out Antonelli to set the fastest time, with a 1m11.622s to the Mercedes driver’s 1m11.647s. Lando Norris hauled his McLaren up to third, 0.131s adrift, followed by Russell and Leclerc – meaning the four top teams lapped within 0.274s.

This time, Lindblad was one tenth quicker than Lawson, with the pair again roughly half a second faster than Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto and Alpine’s Pierre Gasly in the midfield. Hadjar also ended up behind both Racing Bulls in the classification, with a 0.591s deficit to pacesetter Verstappen.
Hamilton’s issue meant he was confined to the garage and performed no soft-tyre run, ending up 12th in the final results.
Debutant Rafael Camara was 15th-fastest, 0.128s quicker than team-mate Oliver Bearman.
Lance Stroll propped up the order after encountering a suspected ERS issue 15 minutes into the session, which proved terminal.
